scope: SEG readout provenance only; source arrays, maskAt, overlays, mesh decoding and source coordinates unchanged

reversible_literal_blocks.current_literal: function maskReadout(raw,p,m){const f=m.source_CT_slice_indices.indexOf(p[2]);return f<0?'no released SEG frame for this CT section · overlay background 0 is display padding':'selected released SEG cell '+raw[p[0]+512*(p[1]+512*f)]+' · original released frame index '+f;}

reversible_literal_blocks.original_literal: const raw=read(ct,p,manifest.ct),where=world(p,manifest.ct);$('position').textContent='Original CT index ['+p.join(', ')+'] · exact LPS ['+where.map(String).join(', ')+'] mm · SOP '+manifest.ct.slices[p[2]].sop_uid;$('values').textContent='Stored integer '+raw+' · original HU '+(raw*manifest.ct.slope+manifest.ct.intercept)+' = raw × '+manifest.ct.slope+' + '+manifest.ct.intercept+' · selected released SEG cell '+maskAt(mask,p,a);$('status').textContent='All '+manifest.ct.source_samples.toLocaleString()+' original CT values and all eight complete released SEG arrays verified. '+($('overlay').checked?'Selected original SEG cells tinted.':'CT samples displayed without SEG tint.');}
